$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFAK (AIP France, chart dated 2026-04-16): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Dunkerque - Les Moëres

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: ATS: NIL. The chart header prints these units to call, which are not services of this aerodrome (its air-air frequency apart): .
After heavy rains, RWY usable with caution, TWY BRAVO likely to be closed by NOTAM.
AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
AD prohibited for class 1 ULM (paramotors) and class 5 (balloons).
Unpaved RWY (638 x 50 m) reserved for airplanes, helicopters and class 3 ULM (multi-axis).
AD likely to be covered by sea haze in a few minutes.
Presence of a guyed antenna (ALT 813 ft) localised to the south of AD circuit.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Avoid flying over Sainte Foy and Saint François farms.
TKOF RWY 25: turn left as soon as possible, route 238° due to obstacles (trees and electricity poles identified at THR RWY 07 and the educational farm "Le Caméléus" in Ghyvelde).
AEM (NR 8354): see AIP ENR 5.5
Après pluies intenses, pistes utilisables avec précaution, TWY Bravo susceptible d'être fermé par NOTAM.
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.
AD interdit aux ULM de classe 1 (paramoteurs) et de classe 5 (ballons)
Piste non revêtue (638 x 50 m) réservée aux avions, aux hélicoptères et aux ULM de classe 3 (multiaxes)
AD susceptible d'être envahi en quelques minutes par la brume de mer.
Présence d'une antenne haubanée (ALT 813 ft) au sud du circuit.
Roulage interdit hors RWY et TWY.
Éviter le survol de la ferme Sainte Foy et de la ferme Saint François.

Décollage piste 25 : prendre dès que possible à gauche cap 238° car présence d'obstacles (arbres et poteaux électriques identifiés au seuil de piste 07 et de la ferme pédagogique "Le Caméléus" à Ghyvelde).
AEM (N° 8354) : voir AIP ENR 5.5
